q_ember_relic.title: The Shattered Flame
q_ember_relic.description: Elara of Embercrest speaks of an ancient Fire Fragment resting beneath the Arch of the Ancients. Retrieve it before hostile zealots claim its lingering power.

objectives.text: Locate and retrieve the Ancient Fire Fragment near the Arch
Return the fragment to Lorekeeper Elara at the Ancient Dais

q_cinderfall_welcome.title: The Embers of Cinderfall
q_cinderfall_welcome.description: Speak with Chieftain Varek and High Priestess Pyra in Cinderfall Village to earn permission to walk the highlands.

objectives.text: Present yourself to Warmaster Varek at the Village Hall
Receive the holy flame blessing from High Priestess Pyra

q_forge_crucible.title: The Smith's Crucible
q_forge_crucible.description: Deliver the raw igneous ore to Forgemaster Kael and configure the three furnace registers to smelt the Obsidian Sun Key.

objectives.text: Deliver Igneous Ore to Forgemaster Kael
Solve the heat registers at the Forge Station

q_beasts_blessing.title: The Beast's Blessing
q_beasts_blessing.description: Journey west to the Lion's Crag and Solar Aerie. Commune with the Sacred Fire Lion and receive a feather from the Sacred Phoenix.

objectives.text: Offer respect to the Sacred Fire Lion at Lion's Crag
Receive the Radiant Phoenix Feather at Solar Aerie

q_molten_crossing.title: The Molten Crossing
q_molten_crossing.description: Cross the lethal boiling lava of the Molten Chasm. Activate Kaelen's Magic Eye [V] to reveal the submerged obsidian stepping stones.

objectives.text: Traverse the Molten Chasm safely using Eye Vision

q_temple_prisms.title: The Pillars of Ignareth
q_temple_prisms.description: Rotate the three Pyre Focus Prisms outside the Temple of the Sacred Pyre to focus solar light and unlock the Caldera Sun Gate.

objectives.text: Rotate the 3 Fire Prisms to align with the Caldera Gate
Insert the Obsidian Sun Key to open the Gate

q_burning_mother.title: The Burning Mother's Verdict
q_burning_mother.description: Confront the goddess Ignareth in the heart of the volcanic caldera and receive the Fire Elemental Stone.

objectives.text: Witness the manifestation of Ignareth in the Caldera
